knownLimitations: Headlight overlays are generic beam images, not composited to match the specific car position in each scene. Ideal replacement: Photoshop/GIMP composites using the actual scene as background.
Scene camera angles differ slightly between morning/day/goldenHour (front-facing car) and dusk/night (rear-facing car). A matched set would improve crossfade continuity.
Day scene contains a visible license plate area with text artifact from the AI generator — consider replacing with a clean crop.
